shortBio.en: Queens of the Stone Age founder; desert-rock riff writer who convened Them Crooked Vultures.
shortBio.zh: Queens of the Stone Age 创始人；沙漠摇滚 riff 写作者，召集 Them Crooked Vultures。

whyHub.en: QOTSA → Them Crooked Vultures: modern hard-rock cross-pollination hub.
whyHub.zh: QOTSA → Them Crooked Vultures：当代 hard-rock 交叉授粉枢纽。

body.en:
Born 1973. Post-Kyuss, builds QOTSA as a rotating cast around repetitive, dry riffs. Songs for the Deaf era and later albums keep the machine-shop approach.

Them Crooked Vultures with Grohl and Jones is the dinner-party band that becomes a catalog entry—Homme as organizer.
body.zh:
1973 年生。Kyuss 之后，以反复、干的 riff 为中心组建轮换人马的 QOTSA。Songs for the Deaf 时期与后期专辑保持作坊方法。

与 Grohl、Jones 的 Them Crooked Vultures 是变成目录条目的聚会乐队——Homme 是组织者。
